snippet.title: LLLOOOT! Gameplay
snippet.description:
Playing the game that Damien Moore and I made. I am not trying particularly hard, here, but it should give an idea of how the game plays. The mansions are procedurally generated, so every game is different.

Play it in a web browser here: https://mcneja.itch.io/lllooot
